Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent game-sprite attack animation atlas for our ORIGINAL industrial-fantasy mine warrior CH01. Reference image is CHARACTER IDENTITY, COSTUME, WEAPON AND PAINTED STYLE only, not a target to retain the old 2x2 layout. Create exactly SIX distinct consecutive frames arranged in a strictly separated 3 columns by 2 rows contact sheet, read left to right then next row. Landscape canvas, ample transparent gutter and outer margins, each full character and entire weapon contained within its own equal cell. No labels, numbers, grid lines, scenery, ground plate, shadows, particles, trails or baked hit flashes. Actual alpha transparency.
IDENTITY: same stocky adult male, short black hair, slight beard, orange/coal-black industrial workwear, ivory neck scarf and rolled sleeves, heavy boots, one massive grated left shoulder plate, right-arm piston apparatus with brass and black hoses, belt lamp, SAME two-handed short heavy orange hydraulic impact tool with a rectangular twin-piston metal head. This is a blunt industrial hammer/ram, never a gun barrel, sword or polearm. Both hands retain a plausible continuous grip. Keep all gear and body proportions stable in every frame, one head and two arms and two legs, same camera and scale.
ACTION: ONE forceful overhead-to-forward-down basic strike with readable intermediate poses. Pose 1: begins lifting from ready, hammer diagonally across chest at shoulder height, hips coil and knees load. Pose 2: hammer fully overhead, elbows bent, heavy loaded anticipation, boots planted. Pose 3: active DOWNSWING halfway between overhead and contact, torso rotates/leans forward, hands at chest height, hammer head moving toward front target at waist height; visibly different from both 2 and 4. Pose 4: CONTACT, strongest forward extension, front knee bends, back leg braces, hammer head low in front, no effects. Pose 5: recoil and FOLLOW-THROUGH, torso lower and elbows begin drawing the hammer back, still clearly below ready. Pose 6: rises back into combat-ready stance, hammer low across front, relaxed elbows, compatible with ready pose in reference.
All six share fixed planted boot positions on the same projected ground baseline relative to their cell; front foot may rotate but neither foot slides or teleports. Keep body anatomical scale constant; crouch naturally reduces crown height, never rescale to fill cells. Detailed hand-painted 2D game sprite with crisp material separation and restrained highlights, legible at 88 world pixels tall. Do not repeat the same pose, invent speed smears, or merely rotate the complete sprite.
CAMERA: exactly reference front three-quarter southeast view, viewed slightly from above, face visible, attack toward lower-right of image. Same view in every cell.
